## Change

Describe the completion behavior changed and why. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint:check`

Mention affected editors, source/live mode coverage, remaining limitations and AI assistance where applicable.
